title: Insitro
summary: South San Francisco company combining machine learning with large-scale biological experiments.
bodyHtml:
Insitro generates its own cellular and genetic data at scale, then trains models to predict disease biology and drug response before committing to a molecule.

It has partnerships with large pharmaceutical companies and an internal pipeline in metabolic and neurological disease.

Why it matters

  • ML-driven target discovery
  • Large internal datasets
  • Pharma partnerships

investmentLens: Private; a platform bet whose milestones are partnerships and IND filings.
